description: Header file defining the VaapiImageDecoder class and related enums, structs, and type aliases for VA-API based image decoding in media GPU context.

classes.name: VaapiImageDecoder
classes.description: Abstract base class for VA-API format-specific image decoders, managing initialization, decoding, and exporting decoded images.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the VA-API wrapper in decode mode with a specific profile and error callback.

methods.name: Decode
methods.description: Decodes an encoded image into an internally allocated VA surface, returning status.

methods.name: GetScopedVASurface
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the internally managed VA surface.

methods.name: GetType
methods.description: Returns the type of image supported by this decoder.

methods.name: GetYUVColorSpace
methods.description: Returns the YUV color space mapping needed for the decoded image.

methods.name: ExportAsNativePixmapDmaBuf
methods.description: Exports the decoded image as a NativePixmapDmaBuf, indicating success or failure.
